title: Bike Rack for Your $4K Studio Apartment
tagline: For the urban cyclist who’s tired of their bike becoming a modern art installation in the living room. This $4,020.79 indoor shelf is perfect for the minimalist who wants to show off their carbon fiber frame while pretending they actually ride it. Ideal for the tiny apartment where your bike is your only furniture.

title: Tactical Tunes for the Apocalypse
tagline: When the zombies come, you'll need more than just bullets. This speaker doubles as a survival kit, perfect for blasting 'Zombie' by The Cranberries while barricading your windows. Just don't expect it to fit in your pocket. Ideal for the prepper who refuses to sacrifice their playlist for the end times.

title: Cuss and Color Your Way to Calm
tagline: For those days when 'deep breathing' just isn't cutting it. Perfect for the artistically inclined road rager, the passive-aggressive office mate, or the parent who needs to vent without scarring their toddler. Now you can channel your inner sailor while staying within the lines. Therapy, but with more F-bombs.

title: Feline Frown Bites
tagline: For when you want to serve disappointment at a party, these Grumpy Cat cake pops are purr-fectly miserable treats to share with friends who will inevitably ask why you're so invested in a cat's scowl.

title: Habit Forming Stress Relief
tagline: For when passive-aggressive prayer circles just aren't cutting it. Need to vent some frustrations about the parish bake sale? This Punching Nun Puppet is here to help. Finally, a theological outlet for all that pent-up righteous indignation. (Band-aids for your knuckles not included.)

title: Nostalgia on the Go
tagline: Remember when your Tamagotchi died because you forgot to change its batteries? Now you can relive that trauma anywhere. Perfect for adults who still carry their childhood pet in their pocket, just in case they need to show their therapist how much they’ve grown.

title: Wine Rack or Pirate Ship?
tagline: For the sommelier who’s also a 7-year-old at heart. This wooden wine rack isn’t just storage—it’s a nautical adventure. Perfect for the dinner party where someone inevitably asks, 'Is that a bottle of Merlot or a treasure chest?' Bonus points if you serve rum in it.

title: Game of Breakfast
tagline: For the morning monarch who refuses to start their day without a hint of Westeros. Perfect for when your hard-boiled egg deserves a throne, and your office mate asks why you're eating breakfast like a Targaryen. Bonus points if you mutter 'Winter is coming' while cracking the shell.

title: Lactose Lunacy: The Dunking Dilemma
tagline: For those nights when you're too lazy to pour milk into a glass but still want to feel like a responsible adult. This set is perfect for the insomniac who needs to justify their 3 AM cookie habit with a side of calcium. Just dunk, sip, and question your life choices—all in one elegant motion.

title: Busty Bones: The Undead's Underwear
tagline: Perfect for your goth phase, but not the one where you actually believe in vampires. Ideal for a Halloween party where you're too lazy to wear a full costume but still want to look like you tried. Bonus points if you pair it with a 'I'm not dead yet' t-shirt. Just don't wear it to a job interview, unless you're applying to be a pirate.

title: Pirate's Last Jam Session
tagline: For the landlubber who wants to shred like a scallywag but can't afford a real ship. Perfect for that 'I survived a mutiny' house party or when your parrot needs a perch that doubles as a power chord. Just don't expect it to scare off any actual pirates—unless they're into power ballads.

title: Mood Mug Alert
tagline: For when you need a mug that judges you, this heat-sensitive wonder changes design with your coffee's temperature, because your morning routine wasn't already dramatic enough.

title: Tactical Butter Knife
tagline: When your morning toast demands an edge, but your local bakery’s ‘artisan sourdough’ is more of a medieval siege weapon. This isn’t just a knife—it’s a statement piece for the breakfast warrior who’s tired of their avocado toast fighting back. Perfect for spreading, slicing, or subtly intimidating your barista.

title: Stealth Mode: Activated
tagline: For those days when you want to blend into the crowd at a yoga class while simultaneously looking like you’re about to rob a bank. This hoodie-scarf hybrid is perfect for the urban ninja who needs to hide their face from exes, avoid eye contact with street vendors, or just pretend they’re in a heist movie. Bonus: it’s machine washable, so you can keep your criminal aesthetic fresh.

title: Nutty Audio for Acorn Enthusiasts
tagline: When your audiophile friend insists on 'organic sound,' but you're tired of their pretentious vinyl collection, surprise them with these walnut speakers. Perfect for the person who wants their music to taste like a fancy trail mix. Bonus: the amp doubles as a conversation piece for when guests ask why your living room smells like a bakery.

title: Goodbye, Retirement Fund. Hello, Regret.
tagline: So, your mid-life crisis needs a turbo boost? Perfect. This hand-crafted, obscenely-priced speedster will let you relive your glory days (which probably involved questionable hair and even more questionable decisions). Just picture it: wind in your thinning hair, alimony payments bouncing, and the faint scent of impending bankruptcy. Enjoy!

title: Mouse for the Featherless
tagline: For when you need to frag with the precision of a neurosurgeon, but your wrist is a tired, sad noodle, this mouse is here to save your KDA ratio.

title: Punch List: A Journal
tagline: For when your passive-aggressive sticky notes just aren't cutting it. This journal is perfect for the office warrior who needs to vent about Karen from accounting stealing their staples—again. Document your rage in style, then politely ask if she'd like to borrow some scotch tape instead.

title: Forest Bathing, But Make It Candle
tagline: For when your tiny urban apartment can’t fit a redwood, but you still want to feel like you’re dodging mosquitoes. These candles smell like ‘campfire regret’ and ‘that one time you got lost in the woods.’ Perfect for convincing your cat you’re actually a wilderness survivalist.

title: Headphones on Life Support
tagline: For when you're on a 12-hour flight and your phone's dead, but your music addiction isn't, these self-charging headphones are a desperate traveler's best friend.

title: Block Party, Literally
tagline: When your garage sale finds start stacking up faster than your Tetris high score, these benches are the perfect solution. Imagine your grandma’s knick-knacks finally finding a home in a way that’s both functional and nostalgic. Just don’t blame us if you start hearing the Tetris theme song every time you sit down.

title: Tentacles for Your Tobacco
tagline: For when you want to add a touch of cephalopod chaos to your smoke sessions, this glass octopus pipe is the perfect companion for a weird beach party or a particularly existential crisis.

title: AT-ACT Your Books Into Submission
tagline: For the Rebel who’s tired of their bookshelf looking like the Battle of Endor. These AT-ACT bookends will finally give your collection the Imperial authority it deserves. Perfect for when your significant other complains about your sci-fi obsession—just remind them you’re not hoarding, you’re fortifying.

title: Nightstand Sidekick for Midnight Snackers
tagline: For those nights when your 3 AM snack attack coincides with your existential crisis, this bedside caddy is your silent partner in crime. Perfect for holding your phone, a half-eaten bag of chips, and that book you swore you'd finish last year. Because who needs a nightstand when you can have a portable junk drawer that moves with you?

title: Rainstorm in Your Bathroom
tagline: For those who want to recreate the 'standing in a thunderstorm while holding a toaster' experience, but without the electrocution. Perfect for the overachiever who showers with a raincoat on or the minimalist who considers a towel optional. Comes with a side of buyer's remorse and a lifetime supply of 'worth it' justifications.

title: Mug That Judges You
tagline: For when you need a morning coffee and a forearm workout to prove to your cat that you're still functional after last night's gaming session.

title: Romance Roulette
tagline: For when 'Netflix and chill' has lost its spark, but you're too lazy to plan. Pull a card: 'Serenade each other with karaoke' or 'Write a haiku about your partner's hair.' Perfect for couples who've run out of things to say but still want to pretend they're in a rom-com.

title: Amp Up Your Keys
tagline: For the musician who can't find their keys, but can shred a solo. This amp-shaped key holder is a must for those who prioritize face-melting solos over adulting.

title: Bored of Roses?
tagline: For the guy who wants to look like he just escaped a 19th-century botanical illustration. Perfect for that awkward first date where you both realize you’re allergic to real flowers. Bonus: They won’t wilt during your existential crisis at 2 AM.

title: Concrete Bonfire for Pretentious Patios
tagline: Because nothing says 'I take my outdoor gatherings seriously' like a $3,225 concrete fire pit that looks like it was stolen from a minimalist art gallery. Perfect for that one friend who insists on hosting 'intimate soirées' in their backyard while sipping craft cocktails and pretending they don’t hear the neighbors complaining about the smoke.

title: Goblin King’s Bargain Bin
tagline: When your '80s nostalgia kicks in mid-therapy session, these Labyrinth dolls are the perfect distraction. Imagine explaining to your therapist why you spent $940 on a Sarah doll to reenact your childhood trauma—complete with a tiny David Bowie to argue with. Bonus: They fit perfectly in your 'I survived the 80s' time capsule.

title: Swiss Army Keychain
tagline: For the over-prepared minimalist who's tired of carrying a toolbox. This keychain is like a MacGyver starter kit—perfect for when you're locked out of your apartment and need to jimmy the door open while also tightening a loose screw on your bike. Just don't blame us if you start solving crimes on your lunch break.

title: Majestic Kitty, Ascended Unicorn
tagline: Is your cat secretly yearning for a higher plane of existence? Perhaps they're tired of chasing laser pointers and demand a touch of the ethereal. This inflatable unicorn horn will confuse the mailman, terrify the dog, and mildly inconvenience your feline overlord. Just try not to laugh when Mittens inevitably tries to scratch it off with extreme prejudice.

title: Spouse or Spy? Find Out Now
tagline: Ever suspect your partner’s ‘business trip’ is just a cover for a secret life as a competitive cheese sculptor? This lie detector won’t catch them in the act, but it’ll at least confirm if they’re lying about it. Perfect for when you’re 90% sure they’re hiding something, but need that extra 10% to justify your own midnight Googling.

title: The Belt That Knows Your Waistline Better Than You
tagline: Tired of your belt playing hide-and-seek with your waist? Enter the Perfect Fit Track Belt, the only accessory that adjusts itself while you're mid-bite into a third slice of pizza. Ideal for those 'I swear I'll fit into these jeans again' moments or when you need to subtly signal to your date that you're not actually a human balloon.

title: Unicorn Poop Soap
tagline: When your bathtub needs a disco ball and your skin needs a spa day, but you’re allergic to actual glitter. Perfect for the person who thinks ‘relaxation’ involves scrubbing rainbow residue off their tub for an hour. Comes with a free existential crisis about why bath bombs are $7.

title: Crochet for the Nerd Herd
tagline: Finally, a way to combine your love for pixel art and yarn. Perfect for that one friend who insists on handmade everything but also has a shrine to the original Star Wars trilogy. Now you can crochet a pixelated R2-D2 while binge-watching The Mandalorian. Just don't blame us if your significant other mistakes it for a tumbleweed.

title: The Pen That Thinks It's a Mood Ring
tagline: Forget ink colors—this pen changes hues based on your 'vibe.' Perfect for the office meeting where you need to subtly convey your disdain for spreadsheets. Blue for 'I’m calm,' red for 'I’m about to throw this pen at you,' and green for 'I just got a raise.' Comes with a hefty price tag to match your corporate suffering.

title: Puzzle Your Way Home
tagline: For the nostalgic cartographer who misses their hometown but refuses to visit. This puzzle turns your old stomping grounds into a jigsaw of memories—perfect for when you're stuck in a hotel room with nothing but your existential dread and a half-remembered map of the place you swore you'd never return to.

title: Love in the Time of Existential Dread
tagline: For when you want to tell your partner 'I love you, but also the world is a chaotic hellscape.' Perfect for that one couple who met at a protest and now bond over late-night philosophy debates. Features a minimalist design with just enough irony to make your relationship feel like a Wes Anderson film.

title: Watch That Survives Your Bad Decisions
tagline: You know that friend who somehow always survives their questionable life choices? This watch is their spirit animal. Perfect for the 'adventurer' who once tried to microwave a burrito in a tin foil hat. Swiss-made, carbon-fiber, and ready to outlast your next 'I can fix this myself' moment.

title: Lumen Lord: Your Phone’s Sidekick
tagline: Tired of your phone’s flashlight being outshone by a birthday candle? This little booster is like a tiny sun for your pocket. Perfect for when you’re trying to read a map in a cave, or when your cat’s midnight zoomies require emergency illumination. It’s not a torch, it’s a *lifestyle upgrade*.

title: Shroom Boom in a Box
tagline: For the urban forager who’s tired of pretending to like store-bought mushrooms. This kit lets you grow your own shiitakes in the comfort of your bathroom—because who needs a shower when you can have a mini forest? Perfect for the college student who wants to impress their vegan roommate or the suburbanite who’s one step away from building a yurt in their backyard.

title: Medieval Nap Palace
tagline: For when your 'I need to sleep' phase overlaps with your 'I want to live in a Disney movie' phase. Perfect for the adult who still believes in knights in shining armor—just replace the sword with a remote control. The drawbridge is optional, but the price is not.

title: Hooked on Being a Villain
tagline: For when your pirate phase needs an upgrade. Perfect for that office Halloween party where you want to be the only one who looks like they raided a Renaissance Faire prop closet. Comes with a hook that’s probably seen more action than your left hand. Just don’t try to fight Peter Pan—he’s got better insurance.

title: Pac-Man Eats Your Feet
tagline: Because your living room needed a giant pellet-muncher, this Pac-Man ottoman is perfect for when you're having a retro gaming party and need a place to rest your feet while yelling at kids to get off your lawn.

title: Nostalgia in Your Pocket (Literally)
tagline: Ever find yourself stuck in a boring meeting, longing for the simplicity of 8-bit graphics? The PocketStripe is your escape. It's a keychain that doubles as a gaming console, because who needs a full-sized device when you can have a tiny one that fits in your pocket? Perfect for those 'I need to look busy but not too busy' moments.

title: Road Rash Roast Chicken
tagline: For the discerning biker who also enjoys poultry prepared with questionable structural integrity. Finally, a way to combine your love of hogs and fowl! Perfect for those Sunday cookouts after a leisurely ride... around the cul-de-sac, because let's be honest, you're not trusting this thing on a real trip.

title: Ski Bum's Sanity Saver
tagline: Lost on the slopes with frozen fingers? These GPS gloves are for you. Because getting separated from your group is a real concern, and so is your inability to read a trail map.

title: Astronomical Earring Prices
tagline: For when you want to wear a celestial body without the gravitational consequences. Perfect for the astrophysicist who moonlights as a pirate or the astronaut who needs to dangle their love for space from their earlobe. Just don't expect it to predict the tides or explain the universe's expansion.

title: Godzilla's Inferno Dance
tagline: Because your desk needed a burning Godzilla to really tie the room together, this figure brings a smoldering monster to your workspace, perfect for those late nights when you're trying to meet a deadline and simultaneously imagine a kaiju apocalypse.

title: Wine Bottle: The Afterparty
tagline: For the sommelier who refuses to let a good bottle go to waste—literally. This lamp is the perfect nightcap for your empty Bordeaux, turning last night’s regret into today’s ambiance. Ideal for the 'I’ll just have one more glass' crowd who now have a light fixture to match their questionable life choices.
